steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each service level is placed by whether it was met and whether a credit was claimed.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 missed service level with no credit claimed

findings.title: Service level missed with no credit claimed
findings.fix: Claim the credit from the vendor

findings.title: Open issue past its due date
findings.fix: Escalate the issue with the vendor

findings.title: Result with no source
findings.fix: Attach the report the result came from

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] vendor-sla-response:12  Service level missed with no credit claimed.
       Fix: Claim the credit from the vendor.
[medium] vendor-issue-14:19  Open issue past its due date.
       Fix: Escalate the issue with the vendor.
[low] vendor-invoice:26  Result with no source.
       Fix: Attach the report the result came from.
Not checked: Vendor processes.
pros: Flags a service level missed with no credit claimed, a result with no source, and an open issue past its due date.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-vendor-review skill on the records for this review.
